The source record's own attestation says Bhattacharjee--Goldstein 2019 Section 1 gives the fixed-point definition but not the asserted continuous Poisson representation; it identifies Bhattacharjee--Molchanov 2020 as the source that does establish that identity.

The supplied attested Definition 1, setup, Condition 3(ii), and Theorem 4(ii) record matches the node's predictable-positive assignment, fixed-outcome, history-only regression, and Gaussian-premise claims.
